_comment: Maps an old VM family (regex on vmSize) to a recommended modern target. {0} is the vCPU count captured from the source size name. targetPreferred is tried first; targetFallback if preferred is unavailable in the region or on quota. prerequisites list what must be true before a resize. estSavingsPct is a ROUGH monthly saving hint (list-price direction, region-neutral) used only to prioritise - always validate with the Azure Pricing Calculator.

defaultTarget.note: No mapping matched - manual review required.

rules.note: AMD general purpose. v6 is Gen2 + NVMe only; verify AMD NVMe drivers in the guest OS.
Intel general purpose. v6 is Gen2 + NVMe only.

rules.family: Dv (Intel general purpose, no local SSD marker)
rules.note: Dv4 -> Dsv6: newer families are 's' (premium-capable). Confirm disks are managed.
Burstable. Bsv2 is Gen2; small footprint, low risk.

prerequisiteMeaning.gen2: If the VM is Gen1, an Azure VM Gen1 -> Gen2 conversion is required before resizing to this target (Track B). Gen2 VMs skip this.
prerequisiteMeaning.nvme-os-check: v6/v7 present disks over NVMe. Confirm the guest OS supports NVMe (recent Windows Server / Linux kernels) or it will not boot. This is the single most common migration failure.
prerequisiteMeaning.premium-disk-check: Target 's' families require managed (premium-capable) disks. Confirm the VM uses managed disks.
